acceptance: The three global skill directories are real directories that one skill-sync config manages, and `skill-sync apply` then `skill-sync verify` against that config pass.
Content the loaders own inside those directories (such as Codex `.system/`) survives an apply.
The skill-sync-skills README and deployment template, its template gate, and todo-db's release-gates step 3 describe the new update path, and the release-snapshot activation steps are removed.
A tested rollback restores the previous state without leaving any loader directory empty or broken.
context:
Created 2026-10-31 when the owner chose to activate global release c6249751 by repointing the links, and to track moving to skill-sync-managed directories as a separate change.

2026-10-31 observation: before the c6249751 apply, `skill-sync preview` on `~/.skill-sync-deployment` reported 93 modified files although only 9 differed in bytes; the rest were mode 600 on disk against 644 in the manifest, and the serving release `cb442602…` had the same 600 modes. The README activation steps copy the store with `cp -a` and never check the snapshot, so drift like this goes unnoticed. Until the migration lands, run `skill-sync verify` on a release snapshot before repointing.
description:
`~/.claude/skills`, `~/.codex/skills` and `~/.agents/skills` are symlinks to `~/.skill-sync-deployment/releases/<sha>/store/skills`. skill-sync builds and verifies the store, but it refuses by design to write through symlinks and has no activation command, so every global update ends with a manual snapshot (`cp -a`) and three `ln -sfn` commands that need owner approval. skill-sync's MIGRATION.md ("Global agent directories") describes the alternative: treat the home directory as an ordinary skill-sync project with its own `skill-sync.conf` and real directories, so an update is "bump rev, apply, verify". It asks for that as its own deliberate change, because a broken loader directory disables skills for every agent at once.

Owning repositories: skill-sync-skills (deployment template, README activation section, template gate in `tests/test_skill_sync_conf.py`, which today rejects home targets) and skill-sync (MIGRATION.md). Tracked here because neither has a tracker; todo-db's `docs/operations/release-gates.md` step 3 refers to the activation step.
